name: azan-clock-app
description: Transform your old Android phone into a dedicated 24/7 prayer time display with automatic azan playback, scheduled duas, and periodic tasbeeh reminders.

scripts.build: npx cap sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && echo 'APK built at: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'
scripts.build-release: npx cap sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && echo 'APK built at: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk'
